T4b acceptance criteria (RRI 44 Med-high):

- local-agent/med_high_gate.py: REQUIRED_MODEL_TAG -> muse-glimmer:30b-q4_K_M; docstrings/reason strings updated from "Qwen27" to "Muse Glimmer".
- All five touched scripts' test suites must pass with updated constant/default assertions.
- EC-1: Gemma Developer's own DEFAULT_MODEL must remain unaffected (decoupling proof).
- Zero remaining qwen3.6:27b-q4_K_M references in a reviewer-default context in these five files.

Independently verified facts before this review:
- python3 scripts/gemma_local_test.py: 37/37 passed
- python3 scripts/gemma_code_review_test.py: 55/55 passed
